references.text: Describes the duties of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle, which included carrying the coverings and curtains of the tabernacle—this explains why they needed wagons for their service.
Details the service of the Gershonites in carrying the tabernacle's hangings, coverings, and veils, which required transport means such as the wagons mentioned in 7:7.
Describes the six wagons and twelve oxen that the leaders brought as a gift offering, of which two wagons and four oxen were given to the sons of Gershon.
Shows the sons of Gershon in action as they carried the tabernacle during the wilderness journey, in accordance with their assigned service.
